gateScope: Eligibility for a controlled texture diagnostic only; not final source fidelity, production geometry, rigging or game integration.

provenance.source: Exact Nano Banana corrected FRONT screenshot JPEG from Gemini container 4bca68acb91fd063, reused from V10
captureLimitations: Low-resolution JPEG UI capture rather than original full-size PNG.
Small white sparkle in lower-right background remains in the exact JPEG; outside character and not certified mark-free.
Single image uploaded through image; all multiview slots None. Hidden surfaces are inferred, not independently guided by the approved back/side views.

reviewEvidence.method: Seven individual actual gray GLB renders plus contact sheet, submitted Nano Banana capture and approved V2 comparison; direct read-only actual GLB edge/connectivity checks. No mesh edits or new AI calls.

headAndFace.result: Sufficient recognizable head/face scaffold for texture inspection; identity not final-approved
observations: Rounded chibi head, central bangs, headphone band/earcups and cheek/chin outline are recognizable from the submitted capture.
Fringe and face surfaces are substantially cleaner than V10; eye regions are no longer hidden by shredded debris.

Eye rims remain rough/asymmetric and the eyes read closed or blank in gray geometry. A texture diagnostic must demonstrate correct large blue eyes, alignment, lashes and expression; gray shape alone does not prove them.

hair.result: Coherent broad lock structure usable for inspection, simplified relative to V2
observations: V11 replaces V10's shredded curtain/terrain with smooth connected-looking broad wavy clumps and intentional-looking curling silhouettes.
Both sides and back show consistent placement behind the headphones and body; the back has smooth continuous broad waves rather than fractal noise.
Several clumps have thin ribbon-like or flattened profiles, oversized loose loops and angular tips; the detailed layered curled locks and tied/root construction in V2 are not exactly recovered.
The extreme long wire/needle terrain is gone, but stylized loop/flyaway forms and small disconnected components still require semantic inspection.

outfitAndLimbs.result: Main shapes readable; fine anatomy and garment detail still incomplete
observations: Mild A-pose, separate legs, shorts, open jacket panels, shirt, belt, large cuffs and sneaker silhouette remain readable across front/three-quarter/profile renders.
Lapels, cuff/coat boundaries and belt/shirt relief are more regular and legible than V10.
Hands have rounded mitten-like/fused digits and cuffs can merge into the palm silhouette; this is not a clean articulated hand model.
Star patches, buttons, gold hardware and source sneaker trim cannot be accepted from the untextured geometry.

volumeAndCoherence.result: Actual closed 3D surfaces present; hidden-surface source fidelity unverified
observations: Profile/top/bottom/back renders show head/body/foot thickness and shaped hair depth, rather than a front-only flat card.
No missing boundary faces were found by the indexed and exact-position edge checks; visible hair-loop gaps are not identified as open boundary leaks.

Ten closed vertex-connected components exist. The dominant component contains 448,244 of 449,582 faces (99.70239%); the other 1,338 faces are small islands whose semantic purpose has not been identified.
Edge closure and positive signed volume do not prove adequate local hair thickness, vertex-manifoldness, no self-intersections or separate riggable parts.

comparisonWithV10.mainChange: Coherent smooth hair and more legible face/garments replace the shredded noisy reconstruction.
comparisonWithV10.eligibilityBasis: Eligibility follows recognizable multi-angle shapes and a stable closed dominant surface, not the face-count reduction or improvement alone.

textureInspectionRequirements: Preserve this actual V11 shape/source provenance; save any texture result as a separate unapproved diagnostic with actual mesh hash and render evidence.
Compare all textured views to the input and V2 for blue eyes/expression, lavender hair, headphone black/gold materials, jacket star patches, white cuffs/shirt, gold trim, shorts and sneaker details.
Inspect hair/face/cuff texture projection, seams and stretching across broad thin clumps and inferred back surfaces.
Check that the lower-right capture sparkle is not projected onto the character or reconstructed as an unwanted artifact.
If a texture workflow regenerates shape, independently verify the returned geometry; this gate does not automatically transfer to a different mesh.
requiredBeforeRigOrGame: Resolve or explicitly approve hair/root/curl silhouette differences against approved V2 and verify hidden back/side garment construction.
Identify the nine small components and remove/rebuild unwanted islands only in a separately reviewed revision; inspect loop/ribbon thickness and self-intersections.
Repair eye-region shape if texture inspection exposes deformations; rebuild clean hand/finger and cuff boundaries for intended articulation.
Create production topology/asset-budget reduction and UV/material maps while preserving accepted silhouette.
Separate/define riggable semantic parts, build skeleton/weights, and test hand/limb/hair deformation and animation clearance.
Obtain actual source-fidelity/texture/production review and game integration checks before replacing assets.
nextAction: A controlled free texture inspection is justified for this shape candidate. Preserve candidate status; texture quality and final source fidelity remain undecided.
